description: Opening a thread from its root id: what one relay answer for the root means. Shared by mobile (thread_root_provider.dart) and desktop (to follow). Rules: docs/message-sync.md#opening-a-thread-from-its-root-id. The answer is to two filters in one query: the root by id, and a deletion (kind 5 or 9005) tagging it. `answer` null means the request failed (timeout, refusal, dropped connection). Events are [id, kind, pubkey, e_tag_or_null]; all carry h = channel. `verdict` is found | deleted | unresolved; only unresolved is asked again after a reconnect. A failed or empty answer never means deleted. An author's deletion (5) counts only when signed by the root's author: the root in the same answer, or `known_root_author` (the root already known from the store or timeline).

cases.name: an empty answer is unresolved, never deleted
the author's deletion with the root is deleted
another author's deletion with the root stays found
an author's deletion without the root and no known root is unresolved
the known author's deletion without the root is deleted
another author's deletion without the root stays unresolved when the root is known
a deletion of another event is unresolved
